archetype: Archetype 5: Luxury & Heritage (Adapted for Islamic Scholarship)

brand.name: বাঙালি ইসলামিক ইনস্টিটিউট (Bengali Islamic Institute)
brand.logo_concept: A modern, minimalist geometric Islamic star seamlessly morphing into an open book or a traditional Bengali arch. SVG implementation using deep emerald (#0A422B) and gold (#D4AF37) accents.

hierarchy.h1: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl tracking-tight font-bold text-primary
hierarchy.caption: text-sm tracking-wide text-text_secondary uppercase

spacing_and_layout.grid_system: Bento Grid approach. grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 gap-4 sm:gap-6 for the main menu items. Mobile-first grid using pure CSS Grid with direct children.

header.style: Glassmorphism header (backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0A422B]/90) with subtle gold bottom border. Ensures high contrast for the top navigation.

profile_banner.style: Deep Emerald (#0A422B) solid background with an overlaid subtle gold geometric watermark pattern (10% opacity). Profile image is circular with a 4px solid gold (#D4AF37) border. Student ID displayed elegantly below.

cards.style: Soft UI variants for grid menu. bg-[#FDFCF9], 1px subtle border (#E5E0D5), soft ambient shadow (shadow-[0_4px_20px_rgba(10,66,43,0.06)]). On hover: -translate-y-1, shadow-lg, border-[#D4AF37]/50 transition-all duration-300.

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-white hover:bg-primary_hover rounded-xl px-6 py-3 transition-colors shadow-md
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border-2 border-secondary text-primary hover:bg-secondary/10 rounded-xl px-6 py-3 transition-colors

sidebar.style: Fixed, h-screen, bg-surface, border-r border-border, shadow-2xl. Drawer style on mobile with smooth transform translate-x animation. Include elegant dividers between link groups.

motion.page_load: framer-motion staggered fade-in up (y: 15, opacity: 0 -> 1) for menu grid cards.
motion.menu_open: spring transition for sidebar drawer overlay and panel.

icons.style: weight='duotone' for elegant illustrative feel. Use primary (#0A422B) and secondary (#D4AF37) colors.
icons.usage: Use illustrative sizes for the grid cards (e.g., 36px to 48px). Ensure icons are visually balanced and center-aligned above the Bengali text.

hero_backgrounds.description: Detailed gold geometric pattern inspired by traditional Islamic art. Use with very low opacity (5-10%) over the Deep Emerald banner to add texture.
Elegant Blue Mosque during golden hour. Great for a welcome/login page background with an emerald overlay.

course_thumbnails.description: Intricate Arabic calligraphy featured on a geometric dome ceiling with gold patterns. Ideal for Quranic or Arabic language course cards.
Muslim student reading/studying. Good for general course thumbnails, 'Live Class' banners, or 'My Courses' empty state.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure white text on #0A422B is > 4.5:1. Use #11261E for text on #F9F6F0. Buttons must have distinct focus states.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid. Example: data-testid='menu-item-live-class' or data-testid='sidebar-logout-btn'.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use pure HTML/Tailwind for the main custom layouts (Profile banner, Grid menu) to achieve the organic bento-grid feel. Use Shadcn only for complex functional components (Dialogs, Tabs, Forms).
CRITICAL: Do NOT use generic 'Inter' for headings. Import 'Tiro Bangla' or 'Hind Siliguri' via Google Fonts in index.css.

Apply 'Archetype 5: Luxury & Heritage'. Reject generic SaaS 'tech' colors. Use parchment/cream (bg-[#F9F6F0]) for the main app background, and deep emerald (bg-[#0A422B]) for the header/profile banner.
Grid Menu Cards: Implement as a responsive grid (grid-cols-2 mobile, grid-cols-3 desktop). Cards should have a soft, tactile, elevated look (1px border, soft shadow), not flat minimalist blocks.
Logo: Create an SVG component named 'BrandLogo' using an overlapping star/arch design in emerald and gold.
Sidebar: Must be a smooth sliding drawer on mobile, overlapping the main content with a dark semi-transparent backdrop. Desktop can keep it hidden behind a hamburger or fixed left.
Implement the Bengali/English language context toggle visually in the header or sidebar.
